name: Abrasive
description: : Gain +1 to Intimidate checks, -1 to Diplomacy and Bluff.

name: Absent-Minded
description: : Gain +1 on Knowledge checks, -1 to Spot and Listen.

name: Aggressive
description: : Gain +2 on initiative checks, -1 to AC.

name: Brawler
description: : +1 on unarmed attacks rolls, -1 on all other attack rolls. This doesn't apply to natural weapons and can't be taken if you have the Improved Unarmed Strike feat.

name: Cautious
description: : Gain +1 dodge bonus to AC when fighting defensively or taking otal defense, -1 to saves vs. fear. You can't take this trait if you are immune to fear.

name: Detached
description: : Gain +1 on Will saves, -1 on Reflex saves.

name: Dishonest
description: : +1 on Bluff checks, -2 on Diplomacy.

name: Distinctive
description: : Gain +1 on Reputation checks, -1 on Disguise.

name: Easygoing
description: : Gain +1 on Gather Information checks, -1 on Intimidate.

name: Farsighted
description: : Gain +1 on Spot checks, -1 Search.

name: Focused
description: : Gain +1 on Concentration checks, -1 on Spot and Listen.

name: Hard of Hearing
description: : Gain +1 on Spot checks, -2 to listen.

name: Hardy
description: : Gain +1 on Fortitude saves, -1 on Reflex saves.

name: Honest
description: : Gain +1 on Diplomacy checks, -1 on Bluff and Sense Motive.

name: Illiterate
description: : Choose any one skill except Decipher Script or Forgery, and gain a +1 to that skill. You are illiterate. You can spend 2 skill points in Speak Language to eliminate the negative effects of this trait.

name: Inattentive
description: : Choose a skill that allows complex skill checks, and gain a +1 bonus to simple skill checks made with that skill. This can be taken multiple time but each time you must choose a new skill.

name: Musclebound
description: : Gain +1 bonus on Strength-based skill checks and ability checks, -2 on Dexterity-based skill checks and ability checks.

name: Nearsighted
description: : Gain +1 on Search checks, -1 Spot.

name: Nightsighted
description: : +10 ft darkvision, -1 Spot in brightlight.

name: Passionate
description: : Gain +1 on Fortitude saves, -1 on Will saves.

name: Plucky
description: : Gain +1 on Will saves, -1 on Fortitude saves.

name: Polite
description: : Gain +1 bonus on Diplomacy checks, -2 on Intimidate.

name: Quick
description: : Your base land speed increases by 10 ft., subtract 1 from your hp gained at each level including first. Result of 0 is possible.

name: Reckless
description: : Gain +1 on melee damage rolls, -1 to melee attack rolls.

name: Relentless
description: : Gain +1 on Constitution checks made to continue tiring effects. If ever you would become fatigued you instead become exhasted.

name: Saddleborn
description: : Gain +1 on Ride checks, -1 on Handle Animal.

name: Skinny
description: : Gain +1 on Escape Artist checks, -2 on Strength checks to aviod being bull rushed or overrun.

name: Slippery
description: : Gain +1 on Escape Artist checks to escape a grapple, and on grapple checks to escape or avoid being grappled. -1 on all other grapple checks.

name: Slow
description: : Add +1 to your hp gained at each level. Your base land speed is halved (rounded down to the nearest 5 foot). You must have a base land speed of 20 ft. to take this trait.

name: Specialized
description: : Choose any one Craft, Knowledge, or Profession skill, and gain a +1 bonus on that skill. Take a -2 penalty on all other checks using the same skill (Craft, Knowledge, or Profession, based on the chosen skill).

name: Spellgifted
description: : Choose a school of magic and gain +1 caster level when casting spells of that school. -1 to caster level when casting spells of any other school.

name: Stout
description: : +2 on Strength checks made to avoid being bull rushed or overrun. -1 on Escape Artist checks.

name: Suspicious
description: : Gain +1 on Sense Motive checks, -1 on Diplomacy and Intimidate.

name: Torpid
description: : Gain a +1 on saves vs. enchantment (compulsion) effects. -2 on initiative checks.

name: Uncivilized
description: : Gain +1 on Handle Animal checks, -1 on Bluff and Gather Information.
